column7: Effect, not just status, for three refusals of pat-restriction-ungated-writes-001: after every restricted persona is refused, the profile is unchanged, the old password still logs in, and no project access request exists (the unrestricted control then creates one, 201, not 409); each control succeeds. Red on main: profile updated (200), password changed (200, after which the owner's PATs stopped authenticating, 401), access request created. PAT-GUARD-3
